title: Pan-Seared Uruguayan Fish
description: A simple and flavorful gluten-free dish showcasing the delicate taste of Uruguayan fish, seared to perfection in a hot skillet.
instructions: 1. Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Pat the fish fillets dry with a paper towel.
3. Season the fish with flaky sea salt, if using.
4. Add a thin layer of olive oil to the preheated skillet.
5. Sear the fish fillets for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
6. Remove the fish from the skillet and set aside.
7. Deglaze the skillet with white wine, scraping the bottom for any browned bits.
8. Serve the fish hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
